s: Who among the following issued the Junnar Edict?
x:
Ushavadatta, the son-in-law of the Western Kshatrapa ruler Nahapana, issued the famous Junnar Inscription (Edict). The inscription records his generous donations to Buddhist monks, construction of caves, provision of water tanks, roads and charitable works. It is an important source for understanding the socio-economic conditions and Buddhist patronage in the Deccan during the early centuries CE.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (3).
